C-17.Name: Markdown hygiene: markdownlint-subset validation + Format document (matrix P0-A/P0-B)
C-17.IntentSummary: Flag and fix agent-grade markdown: a pure line-oriented validator (MD001/003/009/025/032/040) feeds a bus-toggled problems panel with click-to-jump; a pure idempotent formatter (whitespace, blank-line structure, setext→atx, heading-cascade demotion) runs as one undoable Format-document command (Shift+Alt+F); code contents, links, and text semantics are never touched; no new dependencies.

T-001.Title: W1: markdownLint.js — pure rule subset over text lines

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: MD001 heading jumps, MD003 setext/atx mix, MD009 trailing whitespace (outside code), MD025 multiple H1, MD032 missing blank lines around headings/lists, MD040 fenced code without language. Table-driven per-rule fixtures: fires and non-fires; fenced-code contents ignored by every rule.

Fixes MD009/MD032/MD003/MD001 (demote jumps to parent+1); code-block contents verbatim; idempotence fixture (format∘format = format); semantics fixtures (links, inline code, text) unchanged; no-op returns null so the command skips history churn.

T-003.Title: W2: problems panel + editor wiring + preference

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: components/problems/index.vue (projectSearch overlay pattern): bus 'problems' toggles; lists {rule, line, excerpt}; click jumps via bus scroll-to-header slug when the line is in/near a heading, else no-op; preference markdownLint (default true) gates recomputation; editor.vue change handler emits debounced 'doc-markdown-changed'; 'view.problems' + 'view.toggle-markdown-lint' palette commands.

T-004.Title: W2: Format document command + one-step undo

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: 'edit.format-document' (Shift+Alt+F, native Edit-menu entry) → bus 'formatDocument' → editor.vue handler: no-op when the formatter returns null; otherwise setMarkdown(formatted, null, false) — muya's own cursor-setter history push leaves ONE native undo step back to the original (real-muya undo pin in markdown-hygiene.test.js); component tests pin the call args and the no-op path.
V-M-011 scenario (problems panel + format command) with commands incl. the new e2e; graph entries for the new util modules and problems component; grace lint zero findings on changed files.

Playwright: a fixture with a heading jump + trailing spaces shows the problems panel with MD001/MD009 entries (toggle via bus); the format command re-renders the document with the issues gone and the panel empty; idempotent second format is a no-op.

Full vitest green, CI-mode coverage thresholds green, full e2e green; review-1 (correctness/edge cases — formatter idempotence, code-block preservation, history composition) and review-2 (security/contracts — no untrusted-input surface, GRACE consistency) both CLEAN.

Verification.Command: npm run test:coverage; review verdicts in Evidence.

Review-1.Angle: correctness, edge cases (formatter idempotence, fenced-code preservation, history-stack composition, cursor handling)

Review-2.Angle: security (no untrusted input paths), GRACE contract/graph/verification consistency, regression risk
Review-2.PassCriteria: zero findings; contracts match shipped behavior

Evidence.Gates: Scoped: 5 files / 284 tests green (hygiene incl. real-muya one-step undo, problems panel, editor-coverage format cases, commands deep + menu-consistency with the native Edit-menu pin). Full e2e 64 passed / 1 skipped (markdown-hygiene gate incl. store-markdown-equality idempotence pin). Full vitest isolation run: see Reviews line for the final verdict context. cargo check green after the m009_menu addition.
